title: Chapter 229: Dean Of The Academy
content:
Chapter 229: Dean Of The Academy

They never expected that the woman in front of them would really dare to attack them here.

This is the Tiandi Academy, their territory.

There was a loud bang.

The three of them immediately vomited blood and retreated to the distance.

Ao Qing often eats various rare treasures of heaven and earth, and Ao Qing's already powerful body, Ao Qing now has enough physical strength to crush the strong people in the same realm.

Although the three people in front of him are in the Immortal Lord realm, they are even higher than Ao Qing's realm, but they still suffer a great loss when facing Ao Qing.

In the distance, blood was flowing from the corners of the three of them, and their faces were a little ugly.

"Are you going to be enemies with my Tiandi Academy?"

The three of them moved out of the Tiandi Academy behind them to make Lu Xue afraid.

It’s a pity that they saw Lu Xue too simply.

"Xiaoqing, continue."

"Okay, I won't beat them up!"

Ao Qing looked a little excited and continued to go straight toward the three people in the distance.

Seeing this, the three people from Tiandi Academy did not dare to say anything more and hurriedly retreated into the Academy.

Buzz —

I saw a huge light curtain rising from the academy.

Ao Qing bumped into it.

There was a loud bang.

The light curtain was still motionless.

"Hmm? That's so hard!"

Ao Qing looked at the light curtain in front of him, a little shocked.

Lu Xue immediately saw the way.

"Xiaoqing, retreat quickly!"

Hearing this, Ao Qing hurriedly retreated. The next moment, a terrifying attack flew out of the academy, directly blasting a huge gap in the position where Ao Qing was just now.

Suddenly, Lu Xue narrowed her eyes slightly.

The huge movement here has obviously attracted the attention of the strong men in the academy.

The attack just now was a blow from the strong man in the academy, and the lowest strength was also a strong man in the Immortal Saint Realm.

Thinking of this, Lu Xue silently took out the Xuanyuan Sword.

At this moment, Ao Qing had already taken Lu Xue back to the door of Tiandi Academy.

As if he felt something, Lu Xue and Ao Qing immediately looked at the door.

A squeak.

The door slowly opened.

An old man in plain clothes and holding a broom slowly walked out of the door, cleaning the dust and fallen leaves in front of the door as he walked.

Seeing the old man who was sweeping the floor in front of him, Lu Xue frowned slightly.

At this time, the old man suddenly said, "Are you here to study in the academy?"

Hearing this, Lu Xue was silent for a moment and nodded slightly.

"That's right."

"That's it?"

The old man frowned and then looked up at Lu Xue.

Looking at Lu Xue for a long time, the old man's brows were frowning deeper and deeper.

He felt a little uncomfortable when the old man saw it, and Lu Xue immediately asked, "Did you do that attack just now?"

The old man didn't say anything.

Just like that, the two of them looked at me and I looked at you, while Ao Qing was so fierce that she stared at the old man in front of her.

He always felt that the old man had bad intentions.

At this moment, a sound suddenly broke the tranquility of the scene.

"Director, don't be fine."

Dean?

Lu Xue was a little shocked. Is the old man in front of him the director of the academy?

As soon as I came to Tiandi Academy, I actually met the dean.

At this time, Lu Xue and Ao Qing looked back.

I saw that Xiao Yin and the others had reached the top of the stairs that were almost impossible to see at a glance.

"Miss Lu, sorry."

Xiao Yin walked to Lu Xue with apologetic expression.

Lu Xue whispered, "They called my friend a villain."

Hearing this, Xiao Yin was slightly stunned and then looked at the old man in the distance.

At this time, the old man wearing plain clothes and holding a broom in his hand was also looking at Xiao Yin, and his eyes seemed to have suddenly become vicissitudes.

"You girl, you are still alive."

The old man in front of him was inconspicuous in the crowd, and he was the dean of Tiandi Academy.

An Lingyun.

After a million years, the two met again, and An Lingyun felt a lot of emotion.

When we met, Xiao Yin was just a young girl. Now, Xiao Yin has become a peak powerhouse in the Immortal Emperor Realm, standing at the top of the Immortal Realm, and looking down on the immortal world.

"Dean, this is Miss Lu, my Xiao clan's VIP."

At this time, Xiao Yin suddenly said.

Hearing this, An Lingyun looked at Lu Xue again.

He had already known the changes of the Xiao clan and was shocked.

The Xiao clan's huge changes are definitely due to external forces.

Is it her?

An Lingyun immediately denied that an immortal king should not have such great energy.

Then, it should be related.

Thinking of this, An Lingyun sighed slightly and then clapped his hands.

The next moment, the three immortal masters of the Tiandi Academy appeared in front of several people.

"Apologize to Miss Lu."

An Lingyun said directly.

Hearing this, the three of them looked a little ugly, "Dean, we,"

"Apologize."

An Lingyun continued to say without any doubt.

Seeing this, the three of them had no choice but to bend down at Lu Xue, "Girl, sorry."

"What do you want to apologize to me? What I want is your apology to Xiaoqing."

Immediately, Ao Qing stretched out her head forward.

"What did you scold me just now?"

At this moment, Ao Qing looked proud and directly explained what it means to rely on the power of a dragon.

Although the three of them were extremely reluctant, facing the aggressive gazes of the people around them, the three of them finally apologized to Ao Qing.

That's why the incident came to an end.

Then, An Lingyun, the president of Tiandi Academy, personally brought a few people into Tiandi Academy.

Ao Qing also shrank his body and tied it back on Lu Xue's arm.

Walking in the courtyard of Tiandi Academy.

Lu Xue was also a little shocked and looked at everything in the academy curiously.

There is a world in this academy.

From the outside, it is not that big, but after entering, I can see the way inside clearly.

However, compared to the deserted city created by Lu Daosheng, it is still a bit invisible.

As he walked, Lu Xue suddenly said, "This academy is so big, why can't you see anyone?"

Hearing this, Xiao Yin explained: "If there is nothing in the academy, students are usually practicing, not studying all the time."

Although it is a college, it is actually mainly focused on cultivation.

Otherwise, if you just come to the academy to study, you will not have any force to look forward to sending geniuses.

Hearing this, Lu Xue nodded thoughtfully.

At this time, An Lingyun suddenly said, "Are you also studying in the academy?"

Lu Xue looked at An Lingyun, turned her head to look at Xiao Yin and Xiao Luo, and then nodded, "Well, my father asked me to come."

"Your father?"

"Lord of the Wilderness City."

An Lingyun frowned slightly.

A deserted city?

I thought the woman in front of me was not simple, and she must have come from some great force, but I didn't expect it to be such an unknown small town.

I haven't heard of it at all.

Perhaps, this woman was really just lucky to become a VIP of the Xiao clan.

"I will take you to see a few tutors later. You can choose one to study with me."

This treatment is already very good for the academy.

This is also An Lingyun's sake for Xiao Yin's sake.

At this time, Xiao Yin's energy was in sight of the entire fairy world, and no one could ignore it.

After all, this is a peak strong man in the Immortal Emperor Realm who is in his millions of years old.

However, before Lu Xue could respond, Xiao Yin stood up and said, "Dean, I am not here to continue to be a student this time."

These words made An Lingyun slightly stunned.

"You want to?"

Xiao Yin nodded.

"I want to be the tutor of the academy and the inner courtyard. From now on, Miss Lu and Xiao Luo will all follow me to study."

This is very arrogant. If someone else asked this in front of him, he would probably slap the other party and let him recognize his status.

But this was what Xiao Yin said.

An Lingyun just hesitated for a moment, then nodded and agreed.

"Can."
